title: A strong second-order sequential optimality condition for nonlinear programming problems
abstract: A strong second-order sequential optimality condition for nonlinear programming, with analysis of its relation to classical conditions and to sequences generated by penalty and augmented Lagrangian methods.

title: A Smooth Equality Reformulation of Nonlinear Exponential Cone Optimization
abstract: A smooth equality-constrained reformulation of nonlinear exponential cone optimization, with analysis of multiplier restrictions, curvature, and the relationships between KKT and second-order optimality conditions for the two formulations.

title: An uncertainty model for positive-valued parameters with application to robust optimization
abstract: An uncertainty-set model that preserves parameter positivity and admits tractable dual reformulations, with analytical bounds, a probabilistic guarantee, and numerical experiments in photovoltaic–battery operation planning and support vector machines.

title: Second-order sequential optimality conditions for nonlinear semidefinite optimization problems
abstract: Second-order approximate KKT conditions and a complementary variant for nonlinear semidefinite optimization, their relation to weak second-order necessary conditions under stated regularity assumptions, and a penalty-based algorithm.
